Analysis

Static analysis checks the project's consistency and validity before simulation. It detects blocking errors and warnings.

Run the analysis

Click the "Analyse" button in the toolbar. The result is shown in the bottom panel with:

  • The total number of elements analysed
  • The number of errors and warnings
  • The list of problems found, by program (grafcet or ladder) and by element

The Analyse button changes colour: red if there are errors, orange for warnings only, neutral if there is no problem.

Types of checks

  • Project consistency: Main ladder missing or duplicated, ladder not called by Main, duplicate step numbers across grafcets
  • Grafcet structure: initial step missing or multiple, unreachable steps or steps with no successor, invalid or missing links
  • Referrals (source / target): referenced step does not exist, referral with no connection, circular references
  • Ladder structure: networks with no coil, invalid connections
  • System blocks: name missing or duplicated, parameters (PT, PV, control, ET/CV) missing, of the wrong type or referencing a non-existent variable
  • Expressions: syntax of transition conditions and actions (transitions, grafcet actions, comparison and assignment blocks)
  • Variables: references to non-existent variables, incompatible types, assignment to an input variable
  • Junctions: too few branches, disconnected branches, AND divergence with no matching convergence
  • Programs excluded from execution: skipped by every check; a block calling an excluded ladder is reported
  • Hardware configuration: unknown board, pin used by several variables, invalid pin address or capability, type not supported by the board, input read without an address (warning)
  • 3D scene: unknown scene, unbound point (warning), bound variable missing, sensor not bound to an input, actuator not bound to an output or display not bound to a memory variable, incompatible type, sensor bound to several points or already wired to a pin, sensor written by an HMI widget

Click a problem in the list to navigate to the element concerned, in the matching grafcet or ladder.

Example messages

A few common messages and their cause:

  • "The transition has no expression. It can never be crossed.": the condition field is empty.
  • "Invalid expression: a transition must be an expression that returns a Boolean.": the condition contains, for example, a numeric calculation instead of a logical condition.
  • "A transition can only have one direct successor. Use an AND divergence to activate several steps at the same time.": several links leave the same transition directly without going through a junction.
  • "The action is not connected to any step.": an action was dropped on the canvas without being linked to a step.
